title: Chapter 31: Who Is He?
html:
“Eight?”

“Stop joking.”

The remark killed the laughter instantly. In the weak light of Murder by Midnight, the students stared at one another and tried to count.

“Then who’s the eighth person?”

“Don’t panic,” Brother Feng ordered, reaching for his phone. Before he could turn on the screen, the distant rattle of chains suddenly quickened.

“Something’s coming!”

As Brother Feng raised his phone, a costumed figure turned the far corner. Its timing was so perfect that it seemed to have been waiting for them.

“What is that?”

Chains dragged beneath an old doctor’s coat, and the figure carried an oversized theatrical prop at its side. Only Brother Feng managed to stay relatively calm. Ignoring Chen Ge’s earlier warning, he switched on his phone flashlight.

The beam cut down the corridor and landed directly on the performer. The figure stopped, slowly lifted its head, and stared back through a curtain of long hair.

Every student felt a chill. The mask looked like several mismatched faces combined into one, its exaggerated seams visible even from a distance.

The instant the light hit it, the figure lurched into motion and charged down the corridor, chains clattering loudly behind it.

The heavy footsteps and rattling metal filled the narrow passage. One student broke first and ran; the rest followed almost immediately, scattering in every direction.

Some ducked into nearby rooms, while others fled toward the lower floors.

The sudden appearance had shattered their confidence. Once one person ran, instinct did the rest, and the organized group dissolved into frightened individuals.

Xiao Hui had been nearest the stairs. When the costumed figure appeared, the student beside her ran, and she followed without thinking. In that moment, all she wanted was distance from whatever was behind them.

Lao Zhao’s abandoned phone lay forgotten in the corridor as screams echoed through the set and the group broke apart.

Xiao Hui followed the person ahead of her all the way to the first floor. The screams above had barely faded when the uneven clatter of chains began descending after them.

She quickened her pace and refused to look back. Between the music, the darkness, and the distant shouting, staying close to another person felt like the only sensible thing left to do.

She fixed her attention on the silhouette ahead and followed it through the maze of rooms.

At least if we stay together, neither of us has to face this alone.The thought of being left by herself made Xiao Hui move even faster. She reached out, nearly catching the back of the person’s shirt.

With the sound of chains drawing closer, the figure ahead darted into a first-floor room to hide.

A dead end?Xiao Hui stopped in the doorway just long enough to see the other person squeeze into the room’s only cupboard. Her choices were simple: keep running alone or hide with them.

The chains sounded closer. She chose the cupboard. Once the door shut, darkness and silence swallowed her, but the presence of another person beside her was reassuring.

Her makeup had begun to smudge. Holding her breath, Xiao Hui leaned toward the narrow crack in the cupboard door.

A chain glinted outside. The doctor figure paused in the doorway, tapped the frame with its prop, looked around the room, and moved on.

Xiao Hui’s heart pounded so hard she could hear it. She pressed herself farther into the cupboard and silently begged the figure to keep walking.Please don’t come any closer. Please just leave.

The footsteps finally receded. Xiao Hui let out a slow breath and lightly touched the arm of the person beside her. “I think it missed us. Let’s wait a little longer, then find the others.”

Her whisper seemed unnaturally loud inside the cramped cupboard. No answer came. Frowning, Xiao Hui turned toward her companion.

The person beside her was of average height and build.

Not Monkey or Lao Zhao. Brother Feng is taller, and He San is shorter.“Lao Song?” she whispered.

Still no answer. The silence suddenly felt much heavier.Wait. Lao Zhao said there were eight of us…

A cold realization crept over her. Xiao Hui slowly raised her phone and turned the dim screen toward the person beside her. An unfamiliar pale face was staring directly back.

The phone fell from her hand. Two seconds of perfect silence passed before a scream erupted from the cupboard.

Xiao Hui recoiled in the cramped space, struck the back of the cupboard, and collapsed from the shock.

Chen Ge immediately opened the cupboard and checked on her. After making sure she was breathing normally, he used his phone to contact Xu Wan. “Xiao Wan, keep the others away from the first floor for a moment.”

He carried Xiao Hui through the nearest staff access route and out of the scenario.

We definitely need more staff.

After settling Xiao Hui safely in the break area and making sure she could recover undisturbed, Chen Ge returned to the attraction.

One out. Six still inside.He closed the staff passage and called Xu Wan. “Xiao Wan, where are you?”

“Someone is hiding in the first room to the left of the second-floor stairs. I’ll make enough noise to get him moving, and you can surprise him from the other side.”

“Xiao Wan, I think I’ve been a bad influence on you.”

“Boss, you absolutely have no right to complain.”
